value.text: Where robotics already won, and where the remaining wins are all about setup cost.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Arms have done this work for forty years. Everything still contested here — small batches, mixed parts, programming time, quality sign-off — is a cost-of-changeover problem rather than a capability problem, which is a different investment thesis from the mobile and humanoid markets.
advance_criteria: Would change if a capability gap, not a setup-cost gap, became the binding constraint again
